facts.content: Patient reports right knee pain and clicking with running for 2 weeks.

facts.content: Patient is advised to reduce running mileage and pause running if pain forces stopping.

facts.content: Patient is referred to physiotherapy for a full knee assessment and rehabilitation plan.

facts.content: Patient is advised to seek urgent evaluation for persistent swelling, heat, redness, fever, or locking or inability to move the knee.

facts.content: Imaging with MRI is to be considered if physiotherapy examination suggests structural injury such as ACL or meniscal damage.
facts.source_text: Consider imaging (MRI) if physio exam suggests structural injury (e.g., ACL/meniscus)

facts.content: Follow-up is as needed or if symptoms worsen or limit activities of daily living.
